descriptions.inProgress: Took Jay's advice and visited Mrs. Mingming to ask about Alloy, the author of Legend of the Snail. She said her grandfather's latest letter was about #bWing, the Fairy of Ellina#k, and suggested I go see Wing.
descriptions.completed: Wing the Fairy recalls Alloy as the human who obtained Mano's shell and prolonged his lifespan. Let's ask some more questions.
